svg.title: Which OAuth token source do I need?
svg.desc: Decision guide for the Haystack OAuth integration. 1. Does the token ever expire? If not, use OAuthStaticTokenSource. 2. Who does the token act as? The app itself: OAuthClientCredentialsSource. One fixed user: OAuthRefreshTokenSource. A different user on each request: go to question 3. 3. Using a Microsoft Entra Agent ID? Yes: EntraAgentOBOTokenSource. No: OAuthTokenExchangeSource (RFC 8693 or Microsoft on-behalf-of). The last two need a subject_token, the signed-in user's token, on every run. Client credentials, token exchange and Entra Agent ID sources authenticate with a client_secret or with OAuthPrivateKeyJWTSource for a certificate or private key, which needs pip install "oauth-haystack[jwt]". EntraAgentOBOTokenSource takes certificate and private_key directly.
